claim: Most AWS Certification exams do not show a pass or fail result on screen at the end of the test; detailed results are available within 5 business days in the AWS Certification Account under Exam History, and an email is sent when they are ready.
question: When and where does a candidate get the exam result?

values.display: in your AWS Certification Account, under Exam History
values.spoken: in the certification account, under Exam History

qualifiers.condition: unless the results are under review for security or technical reasons

evidence.quote: Exam results, including results for beta exams, will be available within 5 business days after you complete your exam. You will receive an email message when your exam results are available in your AWS Certification Account, under Exam History.

Most AWS Certification exams do not display your pass/fail result at the end of the test. Your detailed exam results will be available within five business days of completing your exam in your AWS Certification Account, under Exam History.

values.display: implementing access policies for encryption keys

claim: The SAA-C03 exam has 65 questions, either multiple choice or multiple response: 50 questions that affect the score and 15 unscored questions that do not affect the score and are not identified on the exam.
question: How many questions does the SAA-C03 exam have, and how many of them are scored?

evidence.quote: 65 questions; either multiple choice or multiple response
Unanswered questions are scored as incorrect; there is no penalty for guessing. The exam includes 50 questions that affect your score.

The exam includes 15 unscored questions that do not affect your score. AWS collects information about performance on these unscored questions to evaluate these questions for future use as scored questions. These unscored questions are not identified on the exam.

note: Fixed id read by tools/web/shell.json. The exam page states the total on the value line under the heading 'Exam format'; the exam guide states the scored and unscored split.

claim: Results are reported as a scaled score of 100 to 1,000, and the minimum passing score is 720.
question: What is the passing score of the SAA-C03 exam, and on what scale?

values.spoken: a scaled score from one hundred to one thousand

evidence.quote: Your results for the exam are reported as a scaled score of 100–1,000. The minimum passing score is 720.
The passing standard is represented by a scaled score of 700 for Foundational-level exams, 720 for Associate-level exams, and 750 for Professional-level and Specialty exams.

claim: A non-native English speaker taking the exam in English can request a 30-minute exam extension, the ESL +30 accommodation; it is requested once, before registering for an exam, and applies to all future exam registrations.
question: What extra time can a non-native English speaker get on the exam, and when must it be requested?

values.display: prior to registering for an exam

qualifiers.scope: per candidate, AWS Certification exams taken in English
qualifiers.condition: non-native English speakers; requested once before registering

evidence.quote: A 30-minute exam extension is available upon request to non-native English speakers when taking an exam in English. The accommodation, “ESL +30,” only needs to be requested once, prior to registering for an exam. It will apply to all future exam registrations with all test delivery providers.
2) Take the written exam in English and request an ESL accommodation for an additional 30-minutes to complete the exam.
